title: Ask Tailark to Edit anything
body: Efficient content creation is our mission. With Tailark, you can effortlessly edit text, generate code snippets, format documents, create visualizations from data, and seamlessly integrate with your existing workflow.

marketing.title: Marketing Campaigns
marketing.body: We'll put together your schedule on automatically. You'll keep app deadlines, and will work on the highest priority items first.

scheduler.title: AI Meeting Scheduler
scheduler.body: Ask the chat to create or update your events. Ask it how much time you've spent on demo calls last week. Or have it prepare today's agendas.
